verses.en: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.
verses.sm: Solomona, o le faatusa lea o le malo o le Mesia O le salamo ma Solomona.

verses.en: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.
verses.sm: Le Atua e, ia e avatua au faamasinoga i le Tupu, ma lau amiotonu i le alo o le Tupu.

verses.en: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
verses.sm: E faamasino e ia lou nuu i le amiotonu, e faamasino foi ma le tonu ou tagata ua puapuagatia.

verses.en: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
verses.sm: E fua mai mauga le manuia mo le nuu, ma mauga iti e fua mai i le amiotonu. E faamasino e ia o e puapuaga o le nuu;

verses.en: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
verses.sm: e faaolaina foi e ia le fanau a e ua matitiva, a e faamomomoina e ia o le ua faasaua.

verses.en: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.
verses.sm: E matatau lava tagata ia te oe a o tumau le la ma le masina, i lea tupulaga ma lea tupulaga.

verses.en: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
verses.sm: E alu ifo ia e pei o le ua i le mutia ua seleseleina, e pei o le timuga e súsú ai le eleele.

verses.en: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
verses.sm: O lana nofoaiga e tupu olaola mai ai le ua amiotonu; e manuia tele ai, seia leai se masina.

verses.en: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
verses.sm: E pule foi o ia e pau mai i le tasi sami e oo atu ile tasi sami; e pau mal le vaitafe e oo atu i tulu'iga o le lalolagi.

verses.en: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
verses.sm: E ifo foi i ona luma o e nonofo i le nuu naumati, e etoeto ile eleele o e ita ia te ia.

verses.en: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
verses.sm: O tupu o Tasesa, ma nuu tu matafaga latou te avane mea alofa; o tupu o Seepa ma Sepa latou

verses.en: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.
verses.sm: te avane mea foai fua. E ifo lava ia te ia o tupu uma lava; e auauna ia te ja o nuu uma.

verses.en: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
verses.sm: Aua e laveai e ia o 18 mativa i lona alaga mai; atoa ma le ua puapuagatia,

verses.en: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
verses.sm: ma le ua leai sona fesoasoani. E alofa atu ia i le ua vaivai ma le ua mativa; e faaola lava e ia e ua matitiva.

verses.en: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
verses.sm: E laveai o ia ia i latou ai le saua ma le faamalo; e silisili foi o latou toto i lona manatu. E soifua lava ia, e avatua foi ia te ia ni auro mai Seepa;

verses.en: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
verses.sm: e le aunoa ona talosia o ia; e faafetaia o ia i aso uma lava. 17 18 19 E taumaía o saito i le nuu i tumutumu lava o mauga; e gasé ona fua e pei o Lepanona; e fuga mai foi tagata o le aai e pei c le yao i le laueleele.

verses.en: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
verses.sm: E faavavau lava lona suafa; e tumau pea lona suafa a o i ai le la; latou te faaamuia i latou ona o ia; e faaarnuia O ia e nuu uma lava.

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.
verses.sm: la faafetaia le ALII le Atua, o le Atua o Isaraelu, na O ia lava na te faja vavega.

verses.en: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
verses.sm: la viia lava lona suafa mamalu e faavavau lava; ia tumu foi le lalolagi uma i lona mamalu; Amene ma Amene.

verses.en: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
verses.sm: Ua faaiuina tatalo a Tavita le atalii o Iese.
